historical_audit_observation.interpretation: The prior fixture is retained unchanged but its reported mismatch is contradicted by this captured-environment adjudication. The cause of the prior observation remains unknown.

operational_rule: This adjudication clears only the specific prior source-regeneration mismatch assertion. It does not authorize running or scoring the historical v2 plan: a future versioned execution design must still pin a genuine benign initial state and utility oracle, a manifest-bound driver, reset and trace provenance, fair baselines, and all other open scientific gates.
non_claims: This is not an LLM, agent, defense, utility, latency, cost, benchmark, or statistical-efficacy result.
It does not identify the cause of the prior mismatch, reconstruct that prior execution environment, or prove AgentDojo is deterministic generally.
It does not validate the historical v2 plan, amend any historical fixture, or authorize Runpod/API/model execution.
The fresh-process topology and self-reported counters are not independent evidence that no process made a model, provider, network, or remote-job call.
